notes: The San Francisco Planning Commission's minutes of its meetings of July - December 1997, from volume 44 of the San Francisco Public Library's deposit at the Internet Archive (44minutesofsanfran1997san, labelled July-Dec 1997). Action minutes, as in 1994 - June 1997: each calendar item prints its case number and planner, the property with its assessor's block and lot, the request, the speakers by name, and the action with the vote and the motion or resolution number. The wireless-antenna applications again carry a staff statement of the building's height and use (a 71-foot medical office building, an 81-foot apartment building, a 60-foot commercial showroom, a 76-foot commercial building, a 238-foot office tower, the Calvary United Methodist Church bell tower, the U.S. Post Office on 19th Avenue, Pacific Bell's 19th Avenue building). Pages were split from the hOCR search text on the Internet Archive page index (first two fields are the text offsets), counting the viewer page among the leaves scandata.xml does not mark addToAccessFormats=false, and every page is dated from the meeting header it sits under. Two kinds of finding: what the Commission decided about a property, dated to the meeting that decided it; and what the calendar states stood on or occupied the property, taken from items withdrawn or still continued when the volume ends. A continuance, a motion of intent, a failed motion, an item under 'Items to be continued' or an informational report is not a decision. Every raw.text span was matched mechanically (punctuation- and whitespace-flexible, per ' ... ' segment) against the page it cites, its header page or the next text page. The minutes name applicants, owners, architects, neighbours, objectors, commissioners and staff in every item; none of them is in any field. Companies, institutions, businesses and named buildings are kept.

coverage.remaining: Every page of volume 44 (44minutesofsanfran1997san, July-Dec 1997) was read: 19 regular meetings, 10 July to 18 December 1997, with their addenda and corrections, two closed sessions (18 September, 16 October) and the special joint hearing with the Redevelopment Agency Commission on the Hunters Point Shipyard EIS/EIR (11 December). No meeting is minuted for 3 or 31 July, 11 September (cancelled on 4 September), 2 or 30 October, 27 November or 25 December. Next: volume 45 (1998), then volumes 46-58 (1999-2005).
coverage.note: 172 OCR pages with text out of 342 viewer pages (346 scanned leaves; the empty ones are blank versos, the library cards and the digitization notice), read in one session by a single reader with no sub-agents.
